title: Curating a team of AI Engineers
author: maxow3n15
selftext: I'm looking for a team of advanced AI technicians to help me build a system that automatically trades XAUUSD. I already have a template of a system and am moreso looking for support with the system, to make sure it runs profitably and efficiently, whilst also having strong risk management. I am looking for a group that will be available to join me on Discord, and that will be willing to help me develop this system into an industrial-level quant-trading kind of system. Feel free to message and send me any proof of work of previous AI systems that you have engineered
